name: image-contact-sheet-agent
description: Workflow agent that transforms a local image folder into an HTML contact sheet using an internal tool.
mission: Scan a local image folder without committing source images.
Generate a local contact-sheet HTML file.
Preserve lightweight evidence and keep generated project files ignored by git.

externalTools.name: node
externalTools.purpose: Run the internal image contact-sheet tool.

internalTools.name: import-images
internalTools.purpose: Step 1: Scan image files and create a project manifest.

internalTools.name: build-contact-sheet
internalTools.purpose: Step 2: Generate an HTML contact sheet from the manifest.

generatedArtifacts.purpose: Generated contact sheets, ignored by default.

hardBoundaries: Never commit source images or generated contact sheets.
Keep implementation details in tools/image-contact-sheet or workflow commands.
fallbackWorkflow: If image handling changes, update tools/image-contact-sheet and keep workflow command names stable.
safetyRules: Command stdout is JSON data for the agent; stderr is diagnostics.
knownLimitations: The generated contact sheet references local image paths; it does not copy or publish source images.
